content.title: Chapter 2 - ADMINISTRATION — Sec. 2-186. - Review by hearing officer.
content.summary:
Not later than five calendar days after the issuance of a decision under this article,
               any party may submit to the hearing officer a written request for supplementation,
               clarification or reconsideration of any issue considered, stating the grounds therefor.
            …

faqs.a:
Not later than five calendar days after the issuance of a decision under this article,
               any party may submit to the hearing officer a written request for supplementation,
               clarification or reconsideration of any issue considered, stating the grounds therefor.
               In the event that such a request is filed, the date of final agency action for purposes
               of appeal shall be the date of issuance of the supplementation, clarification, reconsidered
               decision or a notice of refusal to do so. The time limit for issuance by the hearing
               officer of a supplementation, clarification, reconsideration, or refusal shall be
               15 calendar days.
(Code 1981, § 2-151; Ord. No. 3608, §§ 1, 2, 4-3-2003)
